goal: Replace the obsolete native preview UI with a node-traceable Jetpack Compose implementation of all 56 formal Figma phone boards under 714:10.
non_goals: Do not change Room entities, DAOs, schema exports, migrations, preferences or SecretStore behavior.
Do not change frozen protocol wire values or upload core learning data to FastAPI/PostgreSQL.
Do not implement community content, review mode, companion mode, TTS or undesigned actions.
Do not modify or retire the PWA/Capacitor line.
Do not build a signed or release APK.
acceptance_criteria: Every one of the 56 formal phone boards has an explicit Figma node ID to Compose route/state mapping.
The formal workspace order is Weekly, Home, Global Graph, Community with Home initially selected and Challenge vertically above Home.
No formal route renders Learning Brain, obsolete preview seed copy, fabricated community modules or the global four-dot overlay.
Formal Home, Weekly, Community and Settings pass node-specific screenshot comparison before Batch 1 is complete.
AI role and template copy consistently present the AI as the student and the user as the teacher.
Graph layout uses hierarchical anchors, attraction/repulsion, collision and inertia with semantic zoom from circular overview to card close-up.
Frozen local-first data, protocol and security boundaries remain unchanged.
No signed/release APK is assembled and physical Mate 60 validation is recorded separately from emulator evidence.
do_not_touch: Native Room entities, DAOs, schema exports and migrations
notes: Visual truth comes from current Figma 714:10, while the user-confirmed spatial order overrides stale prototype links.
The shared checkout is dirty; workers must edit only assigned files and must not revert unrelated changes.
